messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize what stays in the observability slice for next sprint. Major asks from ACME and FinMetrics: cost breakdown per-route, basic tracing hooks, and a lightweight error analytics card.
ben: Can we please avoid full tracing rollout? we only promised a tiny hook surface.
nashley: Agree. Suggested cut: dashboard + cost breakdown + trace hook PR with limited sampling. error analytics as a follow-up.
sam: +1. Cost breakdown is quickest: reuse the token-level cost telemetry and surface per-route totals.
maria: Customers want per-route + per-model split. Is that doable without schema changes?
ben: We can map route -> model from request metadata today. per-model cost is approximate but fine for v1. no DB schema changes.
priya: For tracing hooks, do we mean an SDK snippet or server-side sampling config? ACME asked for "span-level traces for inference latency".
nashley: Proposal: expose a minimal header-based hook so customers can opt-in spans at request boundaries. server-side will attach trace_id and sample flag.
ben: Implementation risk: we need a tiny runtime patch to inject trace metadata into logs. low risk but needs infra review.
nashley: infra review is fine, but we need fallbacks: if tracing is disabled, return 204 header so customers know.
maria: Launch criteria idea: dashboard renders per-route cost with 95th latency and error rate, trace hook docs + example (two-line snippet), and error analytics card showing top-5 error message groups.
sam: For error analytics, can we ship a simple grouping by normalized message + route, and defer stack parsing?
priya: yes. groupKey = normalize(err.message) + route. Works for v1.
ben: Timeline: dev for cost dashboard (3 dev-days), trace hook (2 dev-days + 1 infra review day), error card (2 dev-days). total ~8 dev-days.
maria: That fits the sprint if we cut the following: - no A/B release for cost alerts - no full trace sampling UI - no per-token cost drilldown
ashley: +1 to those cuts. Also recommend we add an "experimental" tag on trace hook docs.
priya: Action items: 1) ben open PR for trace header (trace-id + sample=true/false) 2) sam sketch dashboard widget (mock screenshot) 3) ashley write docs snippet and experimental warning 4) maria close scope and notify customers.
ben: Will open PR today. /cc @ops-bot for infra review queue.
ops-bot: infra-review-ticket #4532 created (assignee: infra-oncall). ETA 48h.
maria: Cool. I'll prep the release note and set expectation with ACME that error analytics deeper grouping is next sprint. Anyone opposed?
sam: no objections. ship it. :rocket:
nashley: Fine by me.
priya: thumbs up.
maria: OK locking scope. I'll paste final scope in the ticket and update the roadmap doc. Thanks all.
